`infrastructure` may import only a strictly lower tier. `http/` composes freely
but may never reach into another module's `http/` or `infrastructure/`.

## Routes

- `GET /admin/vinted-reviews`
- `POST /admin/vinted-reviews/featured`
- `DELETE /admin/vinted-reviews/featured/:feedbackId`
- `POST /admin/vinted-reviews/featured/:feedbackId/translate`
- `POST /admin/vinted-reviews/locate`
- `PUT /admin/vinted-reviews/rating`
- `POST /admin/vinted-reviews/rating/scrape`
- `POST /admin/vinted-reviews/scrape`
- `GET /reviews`

## Invariants

<!-- invariants:start -->

- Only the reviews shown on the home page are stored, three at most. Every
  change to that set runs under one transaction advisory lock
  (`lockFeaturedVintedReviews`). A scrape writes nothing.
- A review is stored only from a candidate token this server signed after a
  scrape (`verifyCandidate`): text sent by the browser is never trusted.
- Automatic Vinted feedback is never returned and never counts toward the
  requested number (`isAutomaticFeedback`).
- The server only ever calls a `www.vinted.<tld>` origin parsed from the
  admin-supplied profile URL (`parseVintedProfileUrl`), signed out, read-only.
- No transaction is open while Vinted is called. Vinted requests go one at a
  time per process with a random 1.2 to 2.8 s pause between them
  (`vintedClient.ts`); never parallelize them. Every request has its own
  timeout, every admin request a 25 s deadline (under the front's 30 s),
  every body a byte cap, and one scrape runs at a time per process.
- Translation (MyMemory, free, no key) runs one review and one language per
  admin request, paced one request at a time with a pause
  (`myMemoryClient.ts`), outside any transaction. Choosing reviews never
  waits on it, and a re-choice never erases a stored translation. Tests
  never call MyMemory.
- A member who hides their location on Vinted keeps their city hidden here;
  their country is shown, as Vinted itself shows it.

<!-- invariants:end -->
